changelog: 🎛️ 100 Tools & Desktop PC Power Suite: Comprehensive suite of exactly 100 enterprise desktop-grade tools across Antigravity 2.0, Cloud Code, OpenRouter, Terminal & SSH, Git DevOps, Display/Layout, and Android capabilities with detailed Bengali guidance cards ('টুলের কাজ কি', 'অন করলে কি হইবো', 'কীভাবে ব্যবহার করবেন').

🎙️ Real-Time Conversational Voice Assistant (ChatGPT Style): Hands-free 2-way vocal conversation and task execution with animated pulsing Voice Orb, real-time speech transcription, automatic silence detection, and natural vocal feedback via Text-to-Speech.

⚡ Disconnect-Proof Continuous Voice Dictation: Resolved voice input server disconnects and timeouts with intelligent auto-reconnect, extended silence buffers, and offline on-device speech recognition.

🧹 Clean History State & Lingering Chat Purge: Permanently purged lingering conversation summaries from all 4 storage layers (SQLite databases, brain directories, and proto cache) with zero skeleton lag.

📦 Universal Bootstrap ZIP Installer: Completely overhauled bootstrap extraction for JIN Standard and JIN Termux, supporting any archive from ultra-lightweight (10KB BusyBox/Alpine) to multi-GB rootfs while automatically preserving daemon binaries and agy_ide_bridge.
☁️ Advanced Google Drive Cloud Vault: Full backup and 1-tap restore covering all SQLite conversation databases, summaries, encrypted credentials, user preferences, notebooks, and projects.
🚀 Seamless In-App Updates: Updated package installer intent flags with persistent release signing so users can update seamlessly without uninstalling.
